title: His father's itinerant musical family and deciding on music
summary: Fruit-picking relatives playing bluegrass and gospel, his Baptist organist grandmother, and realizing with Gil Evans's band that music was his life.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I should go back, maybe to -- I talked about my mother's side of the family. My father's side of the family also all played music instruments and they were itinerant workers. They used to go up and down the West Coast, mostly fruit picking. And just get enough money ahead to buy tobacco and food and make some home brew. And they all lived in tents. And we could wake up someday and there'd be three or four tents pitched out next to the house on the empty lot and a fire going. You know, people were more easy-going then. The police would hit them today. But they'd be camped out there and they'd sit around at night and they'd all play guitars and I guess they sang the music. I don't know too much about it but they call it bluegrass music now. And that's the kind of songs they used to sing.

My grandmother used to be an organist in the Baptist church and she knew lots of hymns. Carried this harmonium around and she'd play like a rock and roll bass (humming) and they'd all sit around and sing gospel songs. I think I had a better time with them because they used to get pretty worked up and shoot off pistols in the air.

Yeah. My mother's family is Puritan, my father's family were swingers. My father, oddly enough, never drank. The rest of his family made up for him. And so everybody seemed to play some instrument in my family. I guess it's natural that I just sort of drifted into it. But I realized one day, with Gil Evans' band when we went down to southern California, I was never going to be a priest, I wasn't going to be a doctor. This was really what I wanted to do because this is what I spent my whole time doing, anyhow.
That's the Gil Evans we know?
